text: Ever felt your devices are listening? You browse for something online, a new gadget or a pair of shoes, casually looking.
You consider it, maybe add to cart, then close the tab and move on, thinking nothing of it.
But then, everywhere online – social media, news sites, other apps – that exact same product keeps popping up, almost haunting you.
It's not magic, it's retargeting. When you visited that first site, a tiny invisible tracker, a pixel or a cookie, attached itself.
This tracker broadcasts your interest across the internet, telling other ad platforms, 'This person wants THIS.' So they show you exactly that, again and again.
Now you know. That ad isn't a coincidence, it's a silent system at work, ensuring you never forget what you almost bought.
